claims.title: Separate irreversible old-address interference from reversible trapping and its time cost

quoted_fields.interface: Supplied constant nonnegative rates, a>0, integer L>=1 and stage-specific exponential race/reset premises. B_j must count actual irreversible wrong joining for the first model. In the second model trapping returns the same competent active state, r_esc+x+d_T>0, and the lossless eventual-success/time result additionally requires r_esc>0. Actual polymer contacts, donor selection/escape and chemical processing are not acquired by the formulas.
quoted_fields.failure: The absorption law explicitly reuses U1025-retained-product-diversion under a scoped rate/failure mapping. A positional-contact law is supplied, not measured for the proposed construct. For u_j=B_j/a, -log F_L=sum log(1+u_j), while S_L=sum u_j: linearization needs small hazards. For any b_1>0, F_L<=(a/(a+b_1))^(L-1), so even summable positional interference does not give nonvanishing long-chain fidelity at fixed rates. Reversible capture is not an irreversible error by definition; the effective hazard preserves absorption probability, not the full waiting-time law. Zero escape can make trapping permanent even with no chemical damage. Aging, correlated/nonexponential rates, changing competence and additional losses need a changed model. Old irreversible-mask survival remains valid at its own killing/initial-state interface. No integrated relay, empirical contact law, protecting-group performance or source numerical programme is accepted here.
